IAO:0000115: The general name for the hydrogen nucleus, to be used without regard to the hydrogen nuclear mass (either for hydrogen in its natural abundance or where it is not desired to distinguish between the isotopes).

IAO:0000115: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3-hydroxypropionic acid.

IAO:0000115: A one-carbon compound with formula CO<small><sub>2</sub></small> in which the carbon is attached to each oxygen atom by a double bond. IAO:0000115: The carbon oxoanion resulting from the removal of a proton from carbonic acid.

biological_closure.second_cycle_outside_scope: PWY-5744 is a distinct glyoxylate-assimilation process; shared acetyl-CoA-to-propionyl-CoA branch does not collapse its identity.

source_conflicts_and_dispositions.disposition: Current exact CT assignments use computational HAMAP tiers; the paper reverses alpha/beta locus names and does not establish exact accession construct equivalence.
Species-level complex supported by purified OK-70-fl dimer; exact selected 1220-residue sequence has primary-linked strain submission. Native A9WIU3 is distinct 1219-residue J-10-fl sequence.
Independent exact OK-70-fl submissions replace assumed J-10-fl chain equivalence; retain six native heterodimers and direct coexpression requirement.

source_conflicts_and_dispositions.source: CPLX-7552 component coefficient4 versus primary/native prose3or4
source_conflicts_and_dispositions.disposition: Functional Q8VRG6 enables all three current activities; no unique oligomer stoichiometry asserted.

source_conflicts_and_dispositions.disposition: Direct extract-supported fumarate hydration remains; no exact protein guessed.

source_conflicts_and_dispositions.source: 2001 SDH DCIP/PMS assay; 2002 Fig1 unknown acceptor; 2006 Introduction reduced quinone; current Rhea40524/ARBA
source_conflicts_and_dispositions.disposition: Generic quinone reaction-class selected from explicit sources; physiological quinone species remains unidentified and current J-10-fl protein annotation is inferred.
No obligatory exact physiological metal asserted.

component_scope_dispositions: BC1 fused BCCP tetramer is supported, but holo-ACC stoichiometry is unresolved; general HAMAP heterohexamer is not asserted.
Smt alternative citramalate activity and Mcl alternative methylmalyl/citramalyl activities are outside this first-cycle boundary.
Mcl oxalate inhibition is an in vitro off-pathway inhibitor observation, not inferred physiological regulation.

CT cytoplasm and SDH membrane/peripheral/cytoplasmic-side locations are computational annotations; exact cellular compartment edges are not required to close chemistry and are not transferred to all pathway enzymes.
Potassium and magnesium PCS assay support is included; monovalent substitution and MgATP coupling do not establish universal interchangeable ions or an independently measured metal-binding site.
Pathway induction/growth context is retained without inventing an identified regulatory protein.

late_primary_disposition.inspected_scope: Abstract, Introduction, Methods S5-S7, Results and Discussion; part of long Results output truncated, not claimed as complete reading. Exact construct information directly inspected.
late_primary_disposition.disposition: Methods S5/Table1 identify His-tagged A9WIU3 C-terminal residues550–1219, distinct from selected OK-70-fl Q6QQP7 whole protein. Current partial chemistry supported; construct-specific order, inhibition, kinetics and domain behavior not transferred to native whole-enzyme or assembly claims.
